summary: T1 Energy Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its publicly traded and private warrants (exercisable for common stock at $11.50 per share) will expire on July 9, 2026. As of March 31, 2026, there were approximately 14.8 million public and 9.8 million private warrants outstanding. To settle pre-expiration exercises, public warrants will cease trading on the NYSE at market open on July 9, 2026. The NYSE will file a Form 25 to delist and deregister the public warrants. The common stock (symbol TE) remains listed. The event is a scheduled contractual expiration, not a special situation; watch for any exercise activity near expiry.
